reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so anything that automates Instagram DMs makes me flinch. There are no customer results at all, and a card-required trial that turns into final payments at $147 is a lot of risk when I make under $5k a month.
objection: No reviews, no case studies, no proof it actually books calls, and last time the account got an action block. 'Human pace' is just words to me until someone shows it didn't get their account flagged.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a few agency owners like me (replies and booked calls, with names I can check), plus a trial with no card required or a refund guarantee past day 3.
